title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24

ai_review.summary: Jam‑heavy show with an extended New Potato Caboose; recording sounds solid though details are unspecified.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rate the performance five stars, praising the extended New Potato Caboose and overall jam‑oriented flow despite a one‑hour set limit that forced shorter tunes toward the end. No specific audio issues are mentioned, suggesting the source is at least listenable. The energy feels high and the band stays focused throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and highlight strong musical performance; recording quality is not discussed but no problems are noted, leading to a high overall score with limited data confidence.
